methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); subscription software signals with salesforce.com's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (CRM listed 2004-06-23)

pit_profile.why: 'Salesforce, Inc. (“Salesforce,” the “Company,” “we” or “our”) is a global leader in customer relationship management (“CRM”) technology, enabling companies of every size and industry to connect with their customers through the power of data, artificial intelligence (“AI”), CRM and trust.' 'The market for our service offerings is highly competitive, rapidly evolving and fragmented, and subject to changing technology with low barriers to entry, shifting customer needs and frequent introductions of new products and services.' 'The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our operating results could be harmed.' (FY2025 10-K); DURABLE: no 10-K read calls the business cyclical ('cyclical' appears only of the economy's downturns); of the live themes in taxonomy_eras.json (OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': the FY2025 10-K names cloud computing as salesforce.com's own model, the side that displaces on-premise software, not a substitute for it, and names no offshore delivery; ECOMMERCE, STREAMING, ENERGY_TRANSITION, EV, CRYPTO and GLP1 name no software business), only GENAI is on the watch list: it is scoped to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', and FY2025 10-K names AI vendors among salesforce.com's competitors, company-acknowledged with no market read (the MSFT and GOOG rule)

theme_watch.reason: Live: Salesforce's own FY2025 10-K, under 'The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our operating results could be harmed.', names among its current competitors 'vendors who offer software tailored to specific services, industries or market segments, as opposed to our full suite of service offerings, including suppliers of traditional business intelligence and data preparation products, integration software vendors, marketing vendors, e-commerce solutions vendors or AI software and service vendors' and 'cloud computing development platform companies who may develop toolsets and products that allow customers to build new applications, including AI-augmented applications'. It builds AI of its own: 'Founded in 1999, we bring humans together with AI agents to drive customer success on one deeply unified platform.' The stock trades at 36.5x FY26E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of salesforce.com's software seats specifically.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY18-FY25 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.4%/yr (Q1 FY26 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.2-yr ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23 median

BULL.desc: EPS +44.2%/yr (FY18-FY25 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +44.2%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY18-FY25 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CRM (retrospective, 2025-04-11) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.01x (-9.9% downside to Bear $280.30 / +877.9% upside to Bull $2493.61) | Adj composite 2.10 vs market 1.22: gap +0.88 [UNDERVALUED] | -4% above the EPP floor $265.62 (38x FY26E $6.99) | Conservative 2-yr case: +74.4% total (+37.2%/yr) | At 36.5x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $337.24 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +7.6% YoY in Q4 FY25, forward revenues +6.3-6.9% (Q1 FY26 revenue guide (Q4 FY25 release)); generative AI is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
